designer: AI agent (Claude) proposed the candidates: structure types read from the stoichiometry, a two-part model (does it superconduct, and at what Tc) with a mean and a median rule, one model per family and a seed bag
selection: 5-fold GroupKFold by parent compound on 2,123 3DSC entries, the same folds as round 1; leave-one-family-out reported separately; anchors never used for training or selection
rule: release the lowest-error design that beats Hurricane 1.0 on average and in at least 4 of 5 folds and is not more than 0.5 K worse on the superconducting entries
caveat: SuperCon Tc values are averages over reports of varying quality, doped entries borrow the structure of their parent compound, and picking the best of several designs on the same folds makes its score slightly optimistic

data.source: 3DSC_MP (SuperCon measured Tc matched to Materials Project structures)
data.cite: T. Sommer et al., 3DSC - a dataset of superconductors including crystal structures, Sci. Data 10, 816 (2023), doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02721-y; data CC BY 4.0, github.com/aimat-lab/3DSC

structure_types.123_cuprate: RE Ba2 Cu3 O6+x stoichiometry (YBCO and its rare-earth cousins): two CuO2 planes next to CuO chains
structure_types.214_cuprate: A2 CuO4 stoichiometry (La2-xSrxCuO4 and relatives): single CuO2 planes in a rock-salt stack
structure_types.electron_doped_cuprate: A2 CuO4 with cerium on the A site (Nd2-xCexCuO4, T' structure): doped with electrons
structure_types.Bi_cuprate: bismuth with strontium, copper and oxygen: the Bi-2201, 2212 and 2223 series
structure_types.Tl_cuprate: thallium-based cuprates, among the highest Tc at ambient pressure
structure_types.Hg_cuprate: mercury-based cuprates, the record-holding Hg-12(n-1)n series
structure_types.infinite_layer_cuprate: A CuO2 with no other charge reservoir: infinite-layer (Sr,Ca)CuO2
structure_types.1111_pnictide: RE (or alkaline earth) Fe As O/F with one of each: the LaFeAsO family, Tc up to 55 K
structure_types.122_pnictide: A Fe2 As2 with an alkaline-earth or alkali A: the BaFe2As2 family
structure_types.111_pnictide: A Fe As with an alkali A: LiFeAs and NaFeAs
structure_types.11_chalcogenide: Fe with Se, Te or S and no other cation: FeSe and Fe(Se,Te)
structure_types.122_chalcogenide: an alkali with Fe2Se2: intercalated iron selenides such as KxFe2-ySe2
structure_types.nickel_pnictide: nickel instead of iron in the pnictide or chalcogenide layer: low-Tc cousins such as LaNiAsO
structure_types.115_heavy_fermion: an f element, a Co, Rh or Ir atom and five In or Ga atoms: the CeCoIn5 family
structure_types.122_heavy_fermion: an f element with two transition-metal and two Si or Ge atoms: the CeCu2Si2 (ThCr2Si2) family
structure_types.nickelate_oxide: nickel oxides without copper: the nickelate family, in 3DSC mostly non-superconducting
structure_types.bismuthate_oxide: bismuth oxides with Ba or K and no copper: Ba1-xKxBiO3 and BaPb1-xBixO3, Tc up to about 30 K
structure_types.ruthenate_oxide: ruthenium oxides with strontium: Sr2RuO4, a long-debated candidate for unconventional pairing
structure_types.cobaltate_oxide: cobalt oxides with sodium: NaxCoO2, superconducting when hydrated

inputs.label: Composition statistics
inputs.detail: mean, spread, min and max of 8 element properties, plus the number of elements

items.name: crystal system and lattice centring
items.why: seven crystal systems and four centring types, one-hot

items.name: pg_order
items.why: order of the point group, a single number for how symmetric the crystal is

items.name: vpa
items.why: volume per atom

items.name: density
items.why: density from the composition and the volume per atom

items.name: aniso
items.why: longest over geometric mean of the two shorter reduced-cell edges, a measure of layering

items.name: c_over_a
items.why: c/a of the conventional cell for tetragonal and hexagonal crystals (1 for cubic)

items.name: f_spacing
items.why: volume per f-electron atom to the power 1/3, a proxy for the f-f distance that decides whether f electrons stay local (the Hill limit)

inputs.label: Physics features proposed by the AI

items.name: tm_d
items.why: d electrons per transition-metal atom from charge balance (Cu2+ is d9, Fe2+ d6, Ni+ d9); each family's parent compound sits at a characteristic filling and doping moves it away

items.name: p_cu
items.why: holes per Cu from charge balance (negative for electron doping); cuprate Tc rises and falls with it

items.name: dome
items.why: the empirical cuprate dome 1 - 82.6 (p - 0.16)^2 (Presland and Tallon), largest at p = 0.16

items.name: cu_layers
items.why: Cu atoms per formula unit, a proxy for the number of CuO2 planes; Tc rises from one to three planes

items.name: heavy_block
items.why: share of Hg, Tl, Bi and Pb, the heavy-metal charge reservoirs of the highest-Tc cuprates

items.name: fe_based
items.why: iron or nickel together with a pnictogen or chalcogen, the FeAs- or FeSe-type layer

items.name: f_share
items.why: share of atoms with a partly filled f shell (Ce, Yb, U, Pu and others), the local moments of heavy-fermion metals

items.name: f_count
items.why: nominal f-electron count of those atoms

items.name: mag3d
items.why: share of magnetic 3d atoms (V to Cu), a proxy for spin fluctuations

items.name: nonint
items.why: share of non-integer stoichiometry, which marks doped samples

items.name: n_atoms_fu
items.why: atoms per formula unit as written, a measure of chemical complexity

items.name: oxide
items.why: share of oxygen

items.name: chalcogenide
items.why: share of S, Se and Te

items.name: pnictide
items.why: share of P, As and Sb

items.name: halide
items.why: share of F, Cl, Br and I

learner.two_part: a gradient-boosting classifier gives the probability that the compound superconducts; the regressor, trained on superconductors only, gives its Tc; the prediction is their product

spec.cv: 5-fold, grouped by parent compound (the Materials Project chemical system)

changes: Adds measurable crystal structure: crystal system, centring, point-group order, volume per atom, density, layering (anisotropy and c/a) and the f-f spacing

Adds physics features proposed by the AI: the d-electron count of the transition-metal layer from charge balance, the cuprate hole doping p and its Tc dome, the number of CuO2 planes, heavy-metal charge reservoirs, the FeAs/FeSe-type layer, f-electron share and count, magnetic 3d share and a doping indicator
Adds the share of each common element

Adds structure types proposed by the AI, read from the stoichiometry: 123, 214, electron-doped, Bi-, Tl-, Hg-based and infinite-layer cuprates; 1111, 122, 111 and 11 iron-based compounds; 115 and 122 heavy-fermion compounds; nickel pnictides; nickelate, bismuthate, ruthenate and cobaltate oxides
Splits the prediction in two: whether the compound superconducts, and its Tc if it does

summary.rule: reported as a score only with at least 8 scored measurements; never used for training or for choosing the design
summary.about: Measured Tc of materials outside Hurricane's training data, most of them found after the 2018 SuperCon snapshot that 3DSC is built on. They are only predicted, never used for training or for choosing a design. Each entry carries a reliability grade. Only replicated, ambient-pressure, bulk measurements in Hurricane's four families are scored; thin films, high pressure, metastable states, families outside its training data and single reports are shown but not scored, and refuted claims are listed only to record why they are left out. Lattice parameters are approximate literature values for the conventional cell and serve only as model inputs.
